sentences.text:
Author: N.Tukaramji
Bench: N.Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N.Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No.10072 Of 2025
Order

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS, 2023') seeking quashment of the proceedings in Crime No.521 of 2025 of Raidurgam Police Station, Cyberabad, Rangareddy District, against the petitioners.

entities.text: Raidurgam Police Station, Cyberabad, Rangareddy District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. The petitioners are arrayed as accused Nos.1 to 3 in Crime No.521 of 2025 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 406 of IPC.

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent No.1.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that though the petitioners are determined to see the process through and the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment of less than seven years, the Police concerned have not issued any notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023, as such, the petitioners are apprehending coercive measures against them.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioners are ready to cooperate with the investigation, hence prayed for necessary directions for issuance of notice as per law.
5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that the Police concerned are ready to issue notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023.
6. I have perused the materials on record.

7. Having regard to the fact that the alleged offences are punishable with an imprisonment up to seven years and as the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 3 are ready to engage themselves in the process,
without going into merits of the matter, the petitioners are directed to appear before the Station House Officer of Raidurgam Police Station, Cyberabad, Rangareddy District, within a period of one (1) week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, whereupon, the Investigating Officer shall issue notice on the petitioners under Section 35 (3) of BNSS, 2023 in Crime No.521 of 2025 and take up further proceedings as per the guidelines of Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Raidurgam Police Station, Cyberabad, Rangareddy District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In unison, the petitioners are directed to cooperate with the investigation.
8. With this direction, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
